brief:
Britain's Green Party passed a motion at its Brighton conference declaring Zionism a form of racism, Middle East Eye reported. The vote of 1,022 to 813 made the party officially anti-Zionist and committed it to backing a single democratic state in historic Palestine.

The motion establishes formal party policy opposing Zionism as an ideology rather than merely criticizing Israeli government actions or policies.
dek: Is Zionism Racism? Britain's Green Party has declared Zionism a form of racism. The motion, passed at its Brighton conference by 1,022 votes to 813, makes the party officially anti-Zionist and backs a single democratic state in historic Palestine.
title: Britain's Green Party votes to declare Zionism a form of racism
